length_definition: Python len of the unmodified saved episode instruction: Unicode code points, including whitespace and punctuation. Verified against the saved manifest. Excludes system/response instructions, image markup and action history; not token count.
protocol: One original saved attempt per task; input evaluation splits and levels pooled.

binning.method: From shortest to longest, accumulate complete fixed-width bins until minimum count; merge undersized final group backward. Empty bins have no rate. Never split equal lengths. Grouping ignores success labels.

intervals: Approximate 95% Wilson score intervals using a binomial reference model.
caveat: Related templates and heterogeneous difficulties limit binomial assumptions. This descriptive association does not isolate a causal effect of prompt length.
